subject: Common Factor GWAS warnings and error

messages.author: 80171ab3d7adb6ab
messages.subject: Common Factor GWAS warnings and error
parts:
To all,

2 further questions, arising in same common factor GWAS run:

1. The common factor model without individual SNP effects (run preliminary to the model with SNP effects) did not indicate a Heywood problem - none of the loading factors > 1 and there was no negative variances.  So I ran this model using the commonfactorGWAS function.  However, some of the SNPs generated a warning of negative variances.  Actually, even running the userGWAS models above (modelCF and modelCFalt), there were some SNPs generating a negative variance warning (but not many, may .001%).  Should I run the replication model using the userGWAS function with variances constrained, or just drop the SNPs with the warnings? 

2. Running the commonfactorGWAS in sections (subsetting sumstats by chromosome), I ran into this error:
pfactor_5 <- commonfactorGWAS(covstruc = LDSCoutputTNC, SNPs = p_sumstats_5)

error calling combine function:
<simpleError in match.names(clabs, names(xi)): names do not match previous names>
Error in `colnames<-`(`*tmp*`, value = colnamesresults) :
  attempt to set 'colnames' on an object with less than two dimensions

I have looked at p_sumstats_5: it has exactly same colnames as other subsets that ran, and also it exceeds 200000 SNPS (not empty).  
If you have any insight into this error that would be great.  

Thanks! 

Dan
